long_biography.plain_text:
Fresh from the University of Wyoming, Dimitrios Smyrnios took a route-driving position that put him in direct contact with food customers. He spent the next stages of his career at PepsiCo's Frito-Lay division and Nestle, eventually running Dreyer's ice-cream operation. That background in sales, distribution and consumer brands preceded his appointment to the top job at Schwan's, the frozen-food producer founded by Marvin Schwan.

Smyrnios stressed the value of customer relationships when discussing Schwan's home-delivery heritage. Under his leadership, the company established a unit to develop private-label and co-packing work alongside its established retail and food-service lines. He subsequently held an Americas-wide executive chairmanship within CJ Foods. After leaving corporate management, he endowed a University of Wyoming professorship to strengthen sales education.
